value.how_determined: Standard deviation of the interferometer error signal over the scan.

value.condition: Maximum of the sideband amplitude summed over the first sideband pair.
value.how_located: Parabolic fit to the summed sideband amplitude against stage position.

value.frame: laboratory, z along the beam, y vertical

value.how_determined: Measured against a calibrated photodiode at four photon energies and interpolated.

subtracted.what_was_subtracted: A constant per-pixel dark level averaged over 500 shots with the XUV blocked.
subtracted.how_obtained: Recorded immediately before the scan under otherwise identical settings.

value.how_determined: Manufacturer specification for the constant fraction discriminator.

value.gain_behaviour: Linear to 4000 counts per pixel per shot, compressing above it.

value.configuration: 0.5 m field-free drift, 300 V retardation, microchannel plate with a phosphor screen.

dressing_peak_intensity.basis: A typical on-target intensity for this beamline at this pulse energy; no focal spot was recorded for this run.

direction.frame: laboratory, z along the beam, y vertical

value.how_determined: Second harmonic frequency-resolved optical gating on a split-off arm.

value.how_computed: Per-pixel standard deviation across the twelve scans that were summed.

instrument.value: Attosecond beamline, streaking end station, spectrometer arm B.

value.description: Straight relabelling of the acquisition program's binary dump; no arithmetic on the array.

value.how_determined: Residual gas analyser on the chamber during the scan.

value.source: NIST Atomic Spectra Database, ionisation energies, retrieved 2026-02-11.
NIST Atomic Spectra Database, ionisation energies, retrieved 2026-02-11.

value.how_determined: Backing pressure and nozzle geometry, no in-situ measurement.

target_number_density.basis: A typical interaction-region density for this nozzle at this backing pressure; nothing was measured in the interaction region itself.

value.description: Continuous gas jet from a 100 micrometre nozzle, crossed at right angles 1 mm below the nozzle.

value.how_obtained: Variance of the same 500 dark shots, per pixel, averaged over the array.

value.how_computed: Square root of the summed counts per pixel, before any normalisation.
